reports.title: Artivion Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: Artivion has narrowed its expectations for the full year 2026 and now expects revenue to be in the range of $484 to $492 million, representing growth of 8% to 10% on an adjusted constant currency basis compared to 2025 adjusted revenue1. This compares to the previous range of $480 to $496 million, representing growth of 7% to 11% on an adjusted constant currency basis compared to 2025 adjusted revenue1. This guidance contemplates a continued expectation for currency to represent an approximate one percentage point tailwind for the full year.

Artivion is narrowing its full year 2026 adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $93 to $98 million. This compares to the previous range of $92 to $99 million. This guidance includes the previously articulated expectation to incur approximately $8 million of expense through the full year 2026 associated with the acquisition of Endospan, which closed in May 2026.
The Company’s financial performance for 2026 and future periods is subject to the risks identified below.

1 Full year 2025 adjusted revenue excluded a $2.3 million reserve for estimated payback to the Italian government for fiscal years 2019 through 2025 as a result of legislation adopted in Italy that would require medical device manufacturers to repay previously paid amounts to the extent that such expenditures ostensibly exceed annual regional maximum ceilings. In the fourth quarter of 2025, the Company recorded a liability of $2.3 million as a reduction to revenue as an estimate of the amount that the Company may be required to repay for certain years after 2018. See “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” for important information about our use of non-GAAP measures.
